column2: The installer's boot menu; the first entry starts after 15 seconds
The installer lists the internal disks that can hold Material QEMU
The disk name is typed in and writing starts
The written disk is read back and matches the release's SHA-256
Installed: remove the installer and press Enter to restart
The PC restarts from its own disk into Material QEMU
The console shows the address to open
Opening that address shows the first-run page; the first account becomes the owner
